source: User-supplied resources/lyrics-spelling/彼時的青春-夕陽武士

blocks.text: 想到讀冊時咱輕輕鬆鬆的笑聲
blocks.spelling: siūnn-tio̍h tha̍k-tsheh sî lán khin-khin-sang-sang ê tshiò-siann

blocks.text: 大漢了後你煞無緣故搬離開遮
blocks.spelling: tuā-hàn liáu āu lí suah bô-iân kòo puann lī-khui jia

blocks.text: 較早這條路是咱下課時常會經過的路
blocks.spelling: khah-tsá tsit tiâu lōo sī lán hā-khò sî-siông ē king-kuè ê lōo

blocks.text: 四界攏是咱的聲音
blocks.spelling: sì-kè lóng sī lán ê siann-im

blocks.text: 經過了幾年這條路也已經變無仝
blocks.spelling: king-kuè liáu kuí nî tsit tiâu lōo iā í-king piàn bô-kâng

blocks.text: 但是生活仝款是一工過一工
blocks.spelling: tān-sī sing-ua̍h kâng-khuán sī tsi̍t kang kuè tsi̍t kang

blocks.text: 懷念著過去閣如何 日子也是按呢的過
blocks.spelling: huâi-liām tio̍h kuè-khì koh lû-hô li̍t-tsí iā-sī án-ne ê kuè

blocks.text: 閣卡按怎嘛是袂變
blocks.spelling: koh khá án-tsuánn mā sī buē piàn

blocks.text: 茫茫的人海中想欲將你揣
blocks.spelling: bâng bâng ê lîn hái-tiong siūnn-beh tsiòng lí tshuē

blocks.text: 只是毋知按怎揣
blocks.spelling: tsí-sī m̄ tsai án-tsuánn tshuē

blocks.text: 微微的風對面吹 想著你講一句話
blocks.spelling: bî bî ê hong tuì-bīn tshue siūnn-tio̍h lí kóng tsi̍t kù uē

blocks.text: 勇敢去面對孤單的人 看起來讓你真欣羨
blocks.spelling: ióng-kám khì bīn-tuì koo-tuann ê lâng khuànn khí-lâi hōo lí tsin him-siān

blocks.text: 其實我無想遮濟 因為我看著你上簡單的美麗
